nom: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum for Beginners

avis.titre: Seriously so glad I tried this product
avis.texte: I ordered the trial kit that came with this and the matching eye cream. I came back to buy this again and I was very surprised to see the lower rating, and honestly, the two low ratings I dont believe are quite fair. Ive been using both every night for a few weeks now. I have seen very noticeable differences! It has definitely reduced my wrinkles and pore-sizes. For reference, I'm a W female in my 30s, but just recently started using anti-aging products. I have noticable wrinkles, but this product has definitely helped! I am usually pretty critical and I will not buy a product again at similar price points if it doesnt work. After a few weeks, not only did I notice the results, but I have gotten so many compliments about how I look younger, which has completely stunned me! Ive tried several other anti-aging products, and this is the first one that ive actually received compliments about. I highly recommend this product! Don't let the few negative reviews deter you. I don't know about you, but if a product works, im willing to pay extra for it. Its not unheard of for a product to be expensive, but I'm honestly shocked it's not higher priced, yet works better than some of the prestige brands.

I have been using this for about a month and my skin loves it. Every other retinol I've tried turned me terribly red and irritated my skin. This stuff doesn't irritate my skin at all! I had very little purging. My acne scars are diminished and my fine lines are improving already. New holy grail!!!
I am really liking the product so far but the dropper is not functional and cheap. I can't get it to work at all. you'd think at this price point, some more care would have gone into the packaging
This is a great product, light texture, amazing results for my skin!

The SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum has been one of the most gentle yet effective retinols I have tried. The serum, as you can see in the picture provided, has creamy texture that the skin absorbs so well. It has shown an improvement in my skin texture and brightness. I appreciate that it contains panthenol, which helps calm the skin from the actives. The blend of retinol, retinal and bakuchiol is also an innovative approach to targeting fine line and wrinkles. This is an affordable option that is also great for sensitive skin.

I have oily acne prone skin I've been using this retinol for almost a week now and I wish I got it sooner. Ive noticed my skin is feeling less textured and more plumped. I even had a few bumps that were gone when I woke up. Im experience with retinols but this formula is gentle and I havent had any of the typical purging sensations. You only need a pea size amount as a little bit goes a long way I have even used this on my hands at night and the back of my hands are feeling smoother too. If your looking for a retinol or have been scared by them in the past like myself give this one a try.
Great product. i feel like this is a good beginner retinol. makes skin so smooth. my skin has improved a lot since I started using it.

avis.titre: My absolute hero of the year !
avis.texte: This is literally one of my top favorite serums! The glow is insane. It's perfect for use in the evening:)) Trust me. It's the best retinol serum I have ever used.

avis.titre: LOVE IT ! SERUM OF THE YEAR !
avis.texte: This is absolutely the best serum I have ever tried. I use this every night and it is the best for glowing skin. It's a MUST ! ! ! Highly recommend it !

I've been using this retinol serum for about a month now, and I think it's safe to safe it works wonders for my skin! My skin has never been this smooth and radiant. My skin and pores have profoundly tightened. My tip is 'don't overuse retinol', 2-3 drops was enough for my whole face and my neck.

I have sensitive/combination skin and it's a challenge to find a retinol that works for my skin. Surprisingly, this Some By Mi Retinol worked just fine. Its light, not sticky, and doesn't sting vs. other brands at 0.1% Retinol I had to give up on day 1 because of the stinging pain and redness it caused. It's been a few days and so far my skin feels softer. Looking forward to the long term results with this one. And I like how the container is lightweight. It's travel friendly size so I don't have to worry about repacking or checking in bags. For a frequent traveler, this is a big plus for me.

I've been using this serum for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say it has made such a difference in my skincare routine. The texture feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. I especially love how hydrated and smooth my skin feels every morning. After consistent use, I noticed my skin tone looking brighter and more even. The packaging is also very convenient and feels premium, which makes the whole experience even better. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts longer than I expected. I've tried many serums before, but this one truly stands out. I would highly recommend it to anyone who is looking for a serum that delivers real results without irritation.

avis.titre: The perfect option for Retinol Beginner!!
avis.texte: I've always been curious about retinol, especially as I've started noticing my skin losing some elasticity with age. But honestly, I was nervous because I heard it could make your skin worse if you don't use it properly. After doing some research (and seeing a lot of recommendations on TikTok for beginners), I finally decided to give this serum a try and I LOVE it! 💕 My skin feels so much more hydrated, and my pores look noticeably smaller. I've been using it consistently and can already see the difference. If you're new to retinol and looking for a gentle but effective option, I highly recommend starting with this serum. ✨

This serum gave me pecfect glass skin!!! I've been using it almost every morning and night for about a month, and my skin texture has become so smooth and soft. I even feel like my pores look smaller!! I love this serum so much!!
THE best serum of All, If i had to choose best k skincare Brand It would Be 1000000% some by mi, It has miracles in it, If you Use according to your Skin It do wonders love it so much.

avis.titre: The amount of product vs price point feels like a scam
avis.texte: There is absolutely not 1.0 oz of product in this bottle. From the moment I opened it from the package, the bottle felt basically empty, all of the serum was basically already in the dropper. Couldn't even gage any results if I wanted to

avis.titre: Must have for anti-aging and glowy skin!
avis.texte: I love this serum so much that I am already on my second bottle! Just a little goes a long way, apply it to your cleaned, toned face at night and you will wake up with a nice plump look. I have sensitive skin and this worked well on my face without causing any issues. I even noticed i ditched my night face cream because this (even when used alone) does the job!

avis.titre: This is my holy grail serum
avis.texte: This Retinol Serum is a GOAT. It's the product that helped refine the texture of my skin. I would really recommend this product to everyone!!!! You should try it out! I LOVE SOME BY MI!
Could hardly get any product out of dropper. Completely empty by day 5. So disappointing wanted to love this.

I was so excited to try this serum and finally got my hands on it about 2 weeks ago. I did notice that the dropper was being a bit difficult and that it wasn't grabbing a lot of product. Nonetheless, I got the few drops I could (which wasn't alot)when I'd use it. Somehow I'm already close to finishing this product. Mind you, I use it every other day. My sister happened to get this product earlier today. She called me saying that the dropper is flimsy and not picking up product and that the bottle looks almost empty. Soooo not sure what's going on, but I hope they fix that because it's a great serum!! My skin has been looking very smooth and I think its partly from this every other night. Hope it gets resolved.
